Grade description: Assesses standard lending applications within a delegated limit.
Human Involvement: Review conflicting identifiers before linking records.
Work Result: A credit file linked to the correct applicant.
Evidence: Intake form and identity check log.
Control / Quality: Match two identifiers and flag discrepancies.
Potential risk if failed: Evidence could be assigned to the wrong applicant.

Grade description: Assesses standard lending applications within a delegated limit.
Work Result: A list of missing statement periods.
Control / Quality: Check consecutive periods against the request.
Potential risk if failed: An incomplete period could distort the assessment.

Grade description: Assesses standard lending applications within a delegated limit.
Human Involvement: Decide whether each flagged credit is recurring income.
Work Result: A list of credits for review.
Control / Quality: Review one-off transfers separately from income.

Grade description: Assesses standard lending applications within a delegated limit.
Human Involvement: The analyst owns the recommendation and signs the brief.
Control / Quality: Trace each reason to a verified source.

Grade description: Reviews exceptions and decisions outside the standard lending mandate.
Human Involvement: Confirm the cited clause applies to the case.
Work Result: An exception mapped to a policy clause.
Control / Quality: Use the policy version in force at assessment.
Potential risk if failed: The exception could be assessed under the wrong policy.

Grade description: Reviews exceptions and decisions outside the standard lending mandate.
Human Involvement: The reviewer sets a condition and chooses its owner.

Grade description: Reconciles settled payments and prepares exceptions for review.
Work Result: A linked payment and settlement record.
Control / Quality: Check amount and currency alongside the reference.

Grade description: Reconciles settled payments and prepares exceptions for review.
Human Involvement: Choose an owner when responsibility is ambiguous.
